data.explanation: This letter is an informational contract summary required by German telecom law, not a bill or a request for action. It confirms the tariff, price and cancellation terms of your new mobile contract. There is nothing you need to do now; the app will keep track of your minimum term end and the 1‑month notice period so you know until when you could cancel. Keep this document with your contract records in case you need to refer to the agreed terms later.
